THE 19TH CENTURY PROTOTYPE
(ENGLAND)
England (1848-1868): A single nation
enjoying undisputed global monopoly.
Lasted for decades due to unchallenged
monopoly.
Temporary improvement for the bulk,
permanent benefit for the minority.
One bourgeois labor party arises.
THE 2OTH CENTURY GLOBAL
STANDARD (MODERN ERA)
Modern Era (1898-1914): Four Great Powers
locked in a desperate struggle to divide the
spoils.
Improbable to prevail for long in any one
country due to fierce inter-imperialist
competition.
A handful are bribed while trusts and high
prices increasingly crush, ruin, and torture
the mass of the proletariat.
Bourgeois labor parties are inevitable and
typical in all imperialist countries.

TOTAL GLOBAL
EXTRACTION

profits.
THE SOP: The bourgeoisie can devote
a traction of these superprofits (e.g.
100 million trancs out of a thousand
million) to economically bribe the
upper strata of 'its' workers.
THE DISTRIBUTION: This bribe is distributed via soft jobs, committee appointments (e.g., War Industries Committees), and legal trade
union management roles to create an alliance between the workers of a given nation and their capitalists against other countries.

The Only
Marxist
Line
The victory of revolutionary Social-Democracy is
absolutely inevitable, but it will proceed against
those who advocate unity with the opportunists.
The Mandate:
1. Explain to the masses the inevitability of breaking with opportunism.
2. Educate them for revolution by waging relentless struggle against the bourgeois labor party.
3. Utilize the experience of the imperialist war to expose, not conceal, the utter vileness of
national-liberal labor politics.
